title: Athletico-PR beats Bahia and snaps unbeaten streak
seoTitle: Athletico-PR Beats Bahia, Snaps Unbeaten Streak
subtitle: Result in round 28 of the Brasileirão lifts Furacão into third place
excerpt: Athletico-PR beat Bahia 2-1 at Arena da Baixada, snapping the Tricolor's 11-game unbeaten run and lifting Furacão to third place in the.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Sunday night, Athletico-PR defeated Bahia 2-1 at Arena da Baixada in round 28 of the Campeonato Brasileiro. The result snaps the Tricolor's 11-match unbeaten streak and puts Furacão in third place in the tournament.

Esquivel's goal opens the scoring for Furacão

In the 16th minute, Vargas broke away with speed down the right flank and crossed to Esquivel, who struck a first-time shot into the top corner past goalkeeper Ronaldo to score a wonder goal. The goal gave Furacão an early lead in the match.

Bahia's equalizer with Pulga

In the 26th minute, following a cross from Erick, Mycael failed to make the save and the ball fell to Erick Pulga, who shot first-time into the back of the net to level the score.

Athletico's second goal with Rivaldo

At 23 minutes into the second half, Vargas delivered a low cross and Rivaldo arrived to slot it into the bottom right corner past goalkeeper Ronaldo, restoring Furacão's lead.

Controversial penalty late in the game

In stoppage time, Anderson Daronco awarded a penalty to Bahia following a VAR review. Everaldo stepped up to take the kick, but Mycael made the save, preserving the final scoreline.

Ceni's reaction to the officiating

During the press conference, Rogério Ceni criticized the officiating, arguing that the penalty should have been retaken because Athletico players encroached into the penalty area. He claimed the referee lacked the courage to order a retake.

Teams' upcoming fixtures

Athletico host Atlético-MG on October 8 at 8:00 p.m., while Bahia visit Palmeiras on the same day at 9:30 p.m. Both clubs face important matches following the FIFA international break.

Impact on the championship

With 49 points, Athletico-PR sit in third place, while Bahia, coming off an 11-match unbeaten run, once again face challenges in the final stretch of the season. The result highlights the importance of head-to-head fixtures in the battle for the G-4.

With information from ge, UOL.
